newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Five killed in combat in northeast Colombia.
newsitem.headline: Five killed in combat in northeast Colombia.

text.p: Four leftist guerrillas and one soldier were killed in the latest round of fighting in rural Colombia, authorities said on Tuesday.

Military spokesmen said the fighting, pitting army troops against Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia (FARC) rebels, occurred late on Sunday and early on Monday in northeastern Casanare, Santander and Arauca provinces.
The soldier was killed in a firefight that erupted in the municipality of Tame in Arauca province, near Colombia's border with Venezuela, the spokesmen said.
The FARC, which operates throughout the country, grew out of peasant militias formed in 1948. It was founded as a pro-Soviet group in 1964 and is Colombia's largest and oldest guerrilla organisation.
